Name: CatDad's Seasonal Cute Characters for Ayeisha
Author: caatdaad
Description:
Hello!

If you're like me, you prefer having your characters in Poltergeister's SCA style. This mod aims to bring that style to Ayeisha - The Postal Worker as well. I really hope you enjoy my work!

[b]THIS IS PRIMARILY A SPRITE MOD. [/b]Her[b] [/b]winter outfit includes a basic edit of her default portraits to match the new sprite, but that's all for the time being. I am unfortunately still learning as a portrait artist, so I didn't want to push this mod out with portraits I didn't think were up to quality. Until I reach the point where I think I've created that quality, this will remain primarily a sprite mod. (I also give full permission if anyone is feeling inspired and wants to collaborate on portraits or upload their own portraits to go with my sprites! You'd just have to get TheLimeyDragon's permission as well, of course.)

[size=4][b]Installation:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Download the mod.[/*]
[*]Unzip.[/*]
[*]Put it in your mod folder.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Features:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]4 seasonal outfits inspired by Ayeisha's original design as well as real USPS attire.[/*]
[*]A set of winter portraits that match her winter sprites.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[*]Ayeisha - The Postal Worker[/*]
[/list]

[/list]
